assumptions.dividends: constant continuous annual yield; discrete dividends unsupported

greek_units.delta: price per one currency-unit increase in spot
greek_units.gamma: delta per one currency-unit increase in spot
greek_units.rho: price per +1.0 decimal annual rate (multiply by 0.01 for one percentage point)
greek_units.vega: price per +1.0 decimal annual volatility (multiply by 0.01 for one percentage point)

assumptions.maturity: explicit year fraction; no calendar/day-count conversion performed
assumptions.model: Black-Scholes-Merton; European vanilla; one unit of underlying
assumptions.volatility: annualized log-return volatility in decimal units
